name: Spike Electric Controls
old_description: Spike Electric designs and manufactures low- and medium-voltage switchgear, including arc-resistant models. Custom switchgear features include arc flash mitigation, reinforced enclosures, cycloaliphatic insulation and copper-chrome contacts.
about:
Spike Electric Controls was founded in 1965 in Houston, Texas, as an American electrical equipment manufacturer. The company designs and builds power distribution and control systems for critical infrastructure.

The company engineers and manufactures low- and medium-voltage switchgear, gas-insulated switchgear, and custom power distribution systems. Its vertically integrated operations span electrical engineering, precision machining, forming, welding, finishing, assembly, and in-house testing, supported by a workforce of 500 to 999 employees.

Spike serves commercial, industrial, and utility sectors, with notable projects including power infrastructure for Google data centers, hazardous-location switchracks for Marathon Petroleum, fast-track automatic transfer switch systems for Milton Caterpillar, and custom breaker cells for the Downtown Houston Tunnel installation.

Founded on a stewardship philosophy, Spike emphasizes accountability by keeping engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, and post-delivery support under one roof, aiming to reduce handoffs and accelerate delivery for mission-critical applications.

Operating from a modern 30,000-square-foot facility with a dedicated 15,000 sq. ft. electro-mechanical assembly area, Spinnaker provides complete turnkey manufacturing services including high-speed Surface Mount Technology (SMT) with 4 production lines, through-hole PCB assembly, custom wire harnesses, and complex box-build system integration. Certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 for medical devices, ITAR registered, and adhering to IPC-A-610/IPC-WHMA-A-620 Class 3 workmanship, Spinnaker offers advanced testing solutions—including SPEA flying probe and Dage Quadra 3 X-ray inspection—to support mission-critical medical, defense, telecom, and industrial OEMs.
about:
Spinnaker Contract Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1976 in Tilton, New Hampshire, and has remained family-owned since its inception. The company began as a New England-based electronics contract manufacturer focused on providing turnkey assembly services to regional OEMs.

Operating from a 30,000-square-foot facility that includes a dedicated 15,000-square-foot electro-mechanical assembly area, Spinnaker runs four high-speed SMT lines capable of placing 01005 components, through-hole PCB assembly, custom wire harness fabrication using Schleuniger automated equipment, and full box-build integration. The workforce of 51–200 employees supports turnkey supply chain management, new product introduction, and direct fulfillment.

The company serves medical device, defense, telecommunications, industrial automation, semiconductor capital equipment, and commercial electronics OEMs. Its customer base includes organizations whose products are too complex for smaller contract manufacturers but whose volumes do not attract large-scale EMS providers, as well as those requiring close collaboration during early design phases.

Spinnaker emphasizes flexibility in staffing and equipment allocation per project, rigorous test and inspection processes including flying probe and 3D X-ray, and a customer-centric philosophy aimed at exceeding expectations through responsiveness, on-time delivery, and quality discipline.

name: Spring Solar
old_description: Spring Solar has been serving homeowners since 2016, operating as an efficient, low-overhead company that keeps pricing competitive and transparent. We skip the big corporate price tags and pass those savings directly to you.
about:
Spring Solar was founded in 2016 in Bluffdale, Utah, as a family-owned business focused on residential and commercial solar installation. The company began with a mission to make solar power accessible and affordable for homeowners and businesses across the Intermountain West.

The company designs, permits, and installs custom solar photovoltaic systems, including rooftop panels, inverters, and battery storage. Its team manages the entire process from initial energy assessment through final inspection and system activation, and provides real-time production monitoring for every installation. Spring Solar serves customers throughout Utah, Wyoming, and Colorado, with a service area that includes Salt Lake City, Park City, and surrounding communities.

Spring Solar works primarily with homeowners whose monthly electricity bills exceed $100 and with businesses seeking a return on investment within five years. The company has installed systems for residents in Bluffdale, West Jordan, and Draper, as well as for commercial clients looking to reduce operating costs and capture tax incentives.

Spring Solar differentiates itself with a low-price guarantee that matches or beats any competitor’s quote, 25-year product and manufacturer warranties, and a family-owned structure that emphasizes personalized service. The firm is also a Triple‑E Installer Partner with APsystems, offering microinverter technology backed by a 2026 Best of SLC Award.

name: St. Johns Packaging
old_description: Founded in 1954 by René J. Leclair, St. Johns Packaging is a vertically integrated manufacturer of flexible packaging products that are sold to leading food and consumer product companies. Still controlled by the Leclair family, the company currently operates wholly-owned subsidiaries in Canada, the United States, Mexico, the United Kingdom, China, Vietnam and Australia, employing more than 950 dedicated employees.
about:
St. Johns Packaging was founded in 1954 by René J. Leclair in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec, when the banker and consultant acquired a small waxed-paper operation on the verge of bankruptcy. The business began with fewer than ten employees in a 5,000-square-foot plant serving local bakeries and meat packers. Ownership remains with the Leclair family, now in its third generation, and the company is headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina.

Today the firm operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer of flexible packaging, producing blown polyethylene film (up to five layers), flexographic printing up to ten colors, wicket bags, laminated pouches, lidding films, and laser-perforated fresh-produce films. Eleven facilities across Canada, the United States, Mexico, the United Kingdom, China, Vietnam, and Australia employ more than 950 people and provide capabilities from extrusion through finished bags.

The company supplies food and consumer-product brands in bakery (bread and bun bags), personal care (feminine hygiene and incontinence packaging), pet food, frozen foods, dairy, and fresh produce. Recent acquisitions such as Amcor's UK bakery business and Australia's Flexible Packaging Solutions have expanded its reach in European and Asia-Pacific markets.

St. Johns emphasizes reliability, flexibility, and responsiveness, focusing on a limited customer base to deliver optimal value. Sustainability is a stated priority: all polyethylene wicket bags are recyclable, and the company aims to reduce both plastic and food waste through economically viable packaging solutions.

name: Stammy's Steel
old_description: As an experienced welder and engineer, I have extensive experience and specialized know-how. I believe what really sets me apart from the rest of the industry is my attention to detail and ability to cater to the unique needs of each client.
about:
Stammy's Steel was founded in 2012 in Oakdale, Connecticut by a welder and engineer whose background in nuclear engineering and passion for motorsports led to a fabrication business. The owner began by building custom off-road parts for a trophy truck project and later expanded into the local drifting scene.

The shop provides welding, repairs, and fabrication services, including precision cutting, roll cage fabrication, and metal bending. All bending and welding are performed in-house to control quality and cost. The company also offers mobile welding and repair services across the greater New England region, equipped for plasma cutting and gouging.

Stammy's Steel serves motorsports enthusiasts, off-road vehicle builders, automotive clients, and industrial equipment operators. Customers range from drift teams needing roll cages to facilities requiring large equipment repairs and one-off custom projects.

The founder emphasizes attention to detail and the ability to tailor solutions to each client's unique needs as the core differentiators. The business grew from a reputation for integrity and broad construction knowledge, aiming to deliver bespoke fabrication that cannot be sourced off the shelf.

name: Standard Energy Solutions
old_description: Standard Energy Solutions is a premier renewable energy contractor in the Mid-Atlantic region.  Since 2004, our team has been on the leading edge of renewable energy innovation allowing us to design and install the highest quality renewable energy solutions for our customers.
about:
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, Standard Energy Solutions operates as a renewable energy contractor serving the Mid-Atlantic region. The company began with a focus on designing and installing solar photovoltaic and battery storage systems for residential customers.

The firm provides end-to-end solar installation services, including system design using high-efficiency modules, engineering, permitting, utility interconnection, and installation scheduling. Through its Partner program, it supports independent dealers with proposal design, financing options (loans, leases, PPAs, cash), and a proprietary project management platform that tracks each project from sale to commissioning.

Standard Energy Solutions primarily serves residential homeowners through a network of certified dealer partners. Its Partner program targets solar sales organizations that want to outsource design, permitting, and installation while retaining the customer relationship. The company also works directly with homeowners seeking service or maintenance on existing systems.

The company emphasizes speed and transparency: it offers a 20-day installation completion guarantee for qualified projects, weekly commission payments to partners upon project funding, and 25-year comprehensive product and production warranties. Its proprietary project management system provides automated status updates and weekly review meetings to keep projects on schedule.

about:
Standard Iron Works Inc has operated in the Omaha, Nebraska area since 1942. The company began as a small residential steel supplier with three employees and two trucks, gradually expanding into a full-service fabricator serving both commercial and residential markets.

As an AISC Certified Fabricator, the company provides structural steel fabrication, custom metal fabrication, welding, drilling, cutting, bending, stair and railing systems, priming, galvanizing, and rebar processing. It maintains a stock of American-made steel on site and operates a fleet of trucks for rapid delivery, enabling quick turnaround on projects of varying scale. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

The firm serves residential and commercial construction sectors, with clients including Hy-Vee grocery stores (notably their largest Midwest retail unit), apartment communities in Florida, and regional home builders such as Duffy Brothers Construction, Echelon Homes, Choice Homes, and Regency Homes/Pacesetter Homes.

Standard Iron emphasizes its AISC certification, quality control processes, competitive pricing, and a reputation for reliability built over more than 80 years as key differentiators.

name: Standard Spring Parts
old_description: Standard Spring has been in the leaf spring business since 1923. And as a distributor of high quality leaf springs and truck suspension parts to those who perform the installation, our focus is on others’ success in doing the job right. Standard does not work on the truck directly, but is here to serve and support those who do.
about:
Standard Spring Parts operates from Arden Hills, Minnesota, tracing its roots to 1923 when Percy Emory incorporated Standard Spring Co. in St. Paul. The company began as a blacksmith shop forging leaf springs with fire, hammers, and anvils. In 1944, blacksmith Hilding Ostrom purchased the business, establishing a family lineage that continues today under third‑generation owner Scott Ostrom, his wife Joy, and their son Garrett.

The firm no longer manufactures springs; since 2010 it has functioned as a distributor and warehouse for new leaf‑spring assemblies and related suspension hardware. Its catalog covers custom‑bent U‑bolts, trunnion stands, spring pins, insulator pads, and bolster springs for brands such as Mack, Freightliner, Peterbilt, Hendrickson, and Fruehauf. The operation stocks thousands of part numbers from a single warehouse, serving installers and repair shops rather than working on vehicles directly.

Customers include heavy‑duty truck repair facilities, fleet maintenance departments, and trailer builders that service Class 7‑8 trucks, buses, and trailers. The product range addresses front and rear suspensions for Mack Camelback, Freightliner TufTrac, Peterbilt Low Mount Air Leaf, and Hendrickson Haulmaax systems, among others.

The Ostrom family emphasizes that their role is to support the technicians who install the parts, not to compete with them. This installer‑first philosophy, combined with nearly a century of application knowledge, is presented as the company’s distinguishing advantage.

name: Star Plastic Design
old_description: Star Plastic specializes in custom thermoforming of blisters, clamshells, tray and tray lids to precise customer specifications. Complete design, tooling, and fast turnarounds are only part of the total services we offer.
about:
Star Plastic Design operates from Harbor City, California, where it has provided custom thermoforming services for over 40 years. The company focuses on visual packaging solutions, serving customers across the western United States and beyond from its single facility.

The manufacturer specializes in custom thermoforming of blisters, clamshells, trays, and tray lids to precise specifications. Its plant houses 12 diverse thermoforming machines, including two large-format Sencorp 2500 units for high-volume production with inline cutting, and three CNC milling machines for rapid tooling, modifications, and repairs. The equipment mix enables forming of materials from 7 mil to 70 mil thickness, covering flocked, metalized, PET, PLA, PE, PVC, PS, and ABS. In-house tool design, CNC prototyping, and on/off-line die cutting allow the company to handle prototype runs through to orders of hundreds of thousands or millions of parts.

Star Plastic serves the cosmetic packaging, industrial packaging, and point-of-purchase display markets, and also manufactures steel-ruled dies for the print and packaging industries. Its customer base includes brands needing product packaging, counter displays, container packaging, and specialized applications such as dental and perfume packaging.

Quick turnarounds — often same-day or next-day — and low-volume economies round out its value proposition, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification.

about:
Stark Electronics Inc. was founded in 1938 in New Brighton, Minnesota, as a regional distributor of electronic components. The company serves OEMs ranging from startups to Fortune 500 firms with a line card that includes brands such as Alpha Wire, Conxall, and Orion Fans. In 2024, Marsh Electronics acquired Stark to expand its product portfolio and strengthen its presence in the industrial electronics market, providing Stark with enhanced distribution capabilities and access to a broader customer base.

Through its subsidiary Absolute Quality Manufacturing (AQM), Stark offers custom electrical solutions. AQM produces custom wire harnesses up to 100 feet in length with connectors from Deutsch, Amphenol, and MIL‑STD, as well as cable assemblies ranging from 30 AWG to 4/0 and multi‑conductor cables. The shop also builds terminal block and DIN rail assemblies using franchised lines like Dinkle, UL 508A certified electrical control panels, electro‑mechanical assemblies, and turn‑key panel and box builds.

The combined organization serves the automotive, agriculture, and transportation industries, among others. Its customer base includes OEMs in sectors that require ruggedized cable assemblies for fertilizer sensors, transportation systems, and agricultural equipment.

Stark emphasizes a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction built on decades of experience. The company states that it continuously invests in staff training and cutting‑edge technology to remain at the forefront of the industry, and that its in‑house function testing ensures each assembly meets exacting demands.
